en: A sepia-toned panoramic photograph showing a European city with a river running through it, surrounded by mountains. The photo looks like it was taken from an elevated viewpoint. There is a bridge crossing the river, historic buildings along the waterfront, and the city extends into the background. The text at the bottom left reads 'Graz gegen Norden.' and at the lower right 'FOTO VOM ERIKA-VERLAG 452.'
